# B-0035: complete authorized inventory in the first coding request

Implement the missing complete metadata inventory for RepositoryCodingHost. Its first model-facing request must preserve the objective as its first message and contain exactly one JSON metadata message with repository_id, snapshot_id, source_acquired=false, and resources. Every host-authorized scope resource appears exactly once with address, content_identity, UTF-8 byte_size and boolean editable. Use current authenticated scope values; never include unauthorized paths, source text or absolute host paths. Metadata never supplies an exact source/edit witness.

Repeated preparation must not accumulate inventories. After an admitted source change, the next request must describe the current snapshot and content identities. Account for the complete request including all Tools and continuation; refuse insufficient capacity instead of omitting inventory resources. Preserve currentness refusal, native call/result correspondence, projection, source-grounded edit admission, fixed validation and custody. Existing task_candidates is an incomplete ranked suggestion, not this complete inventory; preserve that optional navigation behavior. Do not create another source identity, index, registry or execution loop. Preserve public signatures and existing budgets.

Only repository.py and navigation.py in src/devtools/agents/coding/ are editable. They own host lifecycle/Prompt assembly and native repository metadata presentation. Sizes: 32031 and 13044 bytes; resulting-source ceiling: 32768 per file. Choose a cohesive bounded change, not unrelated extraction. Tests/settings/docs/other files are read-only. No shell or Git authority.

Public diagnostics: experiments/local_maintenance_task_navigation/focused.py. Assertions specify requirements, not implemented behavior. Hidden acceptance is not disclosed.

The supplied exact source is host-selected Context, not model-requested reads. The supervisor separately supplies an authentic historical decision as handoff. {"text": "def task_entry(
    index: SourceSearchIndex,
    objective: str,
    policy: NavigationPolicy,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Select file-first lexical candidates, not complete inventory or source."""
    files = search_repository_source(
        index,
        query=objective[:MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS],
        mode="file",
        maximum_results=2,
    )
    hits = list(files.hits)
    for hit in files.hits:
        hits.extend(
            search_repository_source(
                index,
                query=objective[:MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS],
                mode="symbol",
                maximum_results=2,
                resource_addresses=(hit.unit.resource.address,),
            ).hits,
        )
    unique = {hit.unit.id: hit for hit in hits}
    selected = list(unique.values())[: policy.maximum_candidates]
    while True:
        view = navigation_feedback(
            tuple(h.unit for h in selected),
            index,
            offset=0,
            maximum_bytes=policy.maximum_bytes,
        )
        rows = cast("list[dict[str, object]]", view["units"])
        for row, hit in zip(rows, selected, strict=False):
            row["retrieval"] = [
                {
                    "view": e.view,
                    "rank": e.rank,
                    "score": e.match.score,
                    "terms": [t.normalized_term for t in e.match.term_contributions][
                        :8
                    ],
                }
                for e in hit.evidence
            ]
        view.update(
            kind="task_candidates",
            complete_inventory=False,
            partial=len(rows) < len(unique),
            next_offset=None,
            selection="objective lexical file search, then scoped symbol search",
            query=objective[:MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS],
            query_partial=len(objective) > MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS,
            instruction=(
                "Candidates may be irrelevant. Choose read_source_unit using unit_id "
                "and snapshot_id for exact source; refine find_source query/path/mode "
                "or explicitly browse if inadequate. No source acquired."
            ),
        )
        if len(json.dumps(view, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) <= policy.maximum_bytes:
            return view
        if not selected:
            msg = "Task candidate metadata cannot fit the host presentation budget."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        selected.pop()", "path": "src/devtools/agents/coding/navigation.py", "version": "cc78eeed5b52d47c139806dae5252e12b61415a8a5a708d6a5dc52959a025a7c", "snapshot": "c798932b850b176f1a4c0e83d76df63f63d8a1a8966b3ddd8874f2691cd871be", "span": [3625, 6146], "name": "task_entry"}

{"text": "def navigation_feedback(
    units: tuple[RepositorySourceUnit, ...],
    index: SourceSearchIndex,
    *,
    offset: int,
    maximum_bytes: int,
    page_size: int = 8,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Bound metadata presentation without pretending it disclosed any source."""
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "repository_id": str(index.snapshot.repository_id),
        "snapshot_id": str(index.snapshot.id),
        "source_acquired": False,
        "coordinates": "half-open Unicode offsets; one-based physical lines",
        "units": rows,
        "next_offset": None,
        "partial": False,
    }
    for unit in units:
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "unit_id": str(unit.id),
            "path": str(unit.resource.address),
            "version": str(unit.resource.content_identity),
            "kind": unit.kind,
            "name": unit.qualified_name,
            "span": [unit.start, unit.end],
            "lines": [unit.start_line, unit.end_line],
            "bytes": len(unit.text.encode()),
            "file_id": str(index.expand(unit).id),
            "parent_id": str(unit.parent_symbol_id) if unit.parent_symbol_id else None,
            "symbol_fallback": dict(index.views[1].fallbacks).get(
                unit.resource.address,
            ),
        }
        rows.append(row)
        # Reserve the bounded pagination fields before checking the next row.
        result["next_offset"] = offset + len(rows)
        result["partial"] = True
        if len(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) > maximum_bytes:
            rows.pop()
            break
    result["partial"] = len(rows) < len(units) or len(units) == page_size
    result["next_offset"] = offset + len(rows) if result["partial"] else None
    if (units and not rows) or len(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False).encode(),
    ) > maximum_bytes:
        msg = "Source navigation metadata cannot fit its disclosure bound."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return result", "path": "src/devtools/agents/coding/navigation.py", "version": "cc78eeed5b52d47c139806dae5252e12b61415a8a5a708d6a5dc52959a025a7c", "snapshot": "c798932b850b176f1a4c0e83d76df63f63d8a1a8966b3ddd8874f2691cd871be", "span": [10999, 13043], "name": "navigation_feedback"}

{"text": "def task_entry(
    index: SourceSearchIndex,
    objective: str,
    policy: NavigationPolicy,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Select file-first lexical candidates, not complete inventory or source."""
    files = search_repository_source(
        index,
        query=objective[:MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS],
        mode="file",
        maximum_results=2,
    )
    hits = list(files.hits)
    for hit in files.hits:
        hits.extend(
            search_repository_source(
                index,
                query=objective[:MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS],
                mode="symbol",
                maximum_results=2,
                resource_addresses=(hit.unit.resource.address,),
            ).hits,
        )
    unique = {hit.unit.id: hit for hit in hits}
    selected = list(unique.values())[: policy.maximum_candidates]
    while True:
        view = navigation_feedback(
            tuple(h.unit for h in selected),
            index,
            offset=0,
            maximum_bytes=policy.maximum_bytes,
        )
        rows = cast("list[dict[str, object]]", view["units"])
        for row, hit in zip(rows, selected, strict=False):
            row["retrieval"] = [
                {
                    "view": e.view,
                    "rank": e.rank,
                    "score": e.match.score,
                    "terms": [t.normalized_term for t in e.match.term_contributions][
                        :8
                    ],
                }
                for e in hit.evidence
            ]
        view.update(
            kind="task_candidates",
            complete_inventory=False,
            partial=len(rows) < len(unique),
            next_offset=None,
            selection="objective lexical file search, then scoped symbol search",
            query=objective[:MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS],
            query_partial=len(objective) > MAXIMUM_NAVIGATION_QUERY_CHARACTERS,
            instruction=(
                "Candidates may be irrelevant. Choose read_source_unit using unit_id "
                "and snapshot_id for exact source; refine find_source query/path/mode "
                "or explicitly browse if inadequate. No source acquired."
            ),
        )
        if len(json.dumps(view, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) <= policy.maximum_bytes:
            return view
        if not selected:
            msg = "Task candidate metadata cannot fit the host presentation budget."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        selected.pop()", "path": "src/devtools/agents/coding/navigation.py", "version": "cc78eeed5b52d47c139806dae5252e12b61415a8a5a708d6a5dc52959a025a7c", "snapshot": "c798932b850b176f1a4c0e83d76df63f63d8a1a8966b3ddd8874f2691cd871be", "span": [3625, 6146], "name": "task_entry"}

{"text": "def navigation_feedback(
    units: tuple[RepositorySourceUnit, ...],
    index: SourceSearchIndex,
    *,
    offset: int,
    maximum_bytes: int,
    page_size: int = 8,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Bound metadata presentation without pretending it disclosed any source."""
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "repository_id": str(index.snapshot.repository_id),
        "snapshot_id": str(index.snapshot.id),
        "source_acquired": False,
        "coordinates": "half-open Unicode offsets; one-based physical lines",
        "units": rows,
        "next_offset": None,
        "partial": False,
    }
    for unit in units:
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "unit_id": str(unit.id),
            "path": str(unit.resource.address),
            "version": str(unit.resource.content_identity),
            "kind": unit.kind,
            "name": unit.qualified_name,
            "span": [unit.start, unit.end],
            "lines": [unit.start_line, unit.end_line],
            "bytes": len(unit.text.encode()),
            "file_id": str(index.expand(unit).id),
            "parent_id": str(unit.parent_symbol_id) if unit.parent_symbol_id else None,
            "symbol_fallback": dict(index.views[1].fallbacks).get(
                unit.resource.address,
            ),
        }
        rows.append(row)
        # Reserve the bounded pagination fields before checking the next row.
        result["next_offset"] = offset + len(rows)
        result["partial"] = True
        if len(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) > maximum_bytes:
            rows.pop()
            break
    result["partial"] = len(rows) < len(units) or len(units) == page_size
    result["next_offset"] = offset + len(rows) if result["partial"] else None
    if (units and not rows) or len(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False).encode(),
    ) > maximum_bytes:
        msg = "Source navigation metadata cannot fit its disclosure bound."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return result", "path": "src/devtools/agents/coding/navigation.py", "version": "cc78eeed5b52d47c139806dae5252e12b61415a8a5a708d6a5dc52959a025a7c", "snapshot": "c798932b850b176f1a4c0e83d76df63f63d8a1a8966b3ddd8874f2691cd871be", "span": [10999, 13043], "name": "navigation_feedback"}
